questions.subject: Physics
questions.q:
The potential energy of a point particle of mass $m$ undergoing rectilinear motion along the x -axis is given by
$V(x)=A x+B x^2$
What is the maximum speed attained by the particle if it starts from rest at $x=\frac{A}{B}$ ?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: An object of mass 100 g is sliding under gravity from point A to point B on a frictionless slide from a height of 5 m, as shown in the figure. After what distance will the object stop on the following flat track beyond point B if the coefficient of kinetic friction between the flat track and the object is \(0.5 ?\)

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A solid bob of a material having density twice that of water is suspended with a massless and inextensible string of length $L$. The whole set-up is placed inside a water-filled tank. The bob is imparted a horizontal velocity $V_0$ at the lowest point A, while the other end of the string is fixed, such that the bob completes a semi-circular trajectory in the vertical plane. The string becomes slack only when the bob reaches the topmost point C. Assume that the effects of viscosity and water currents are negligible. The acceleration due to gravity is $g$. What is the expression for $V_0$ ?
